notes.title: Pre Next Fest Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you so much for playing Parcel Dash and providing lots of feedback. The support has been amazing! We’ve got a huge pre Next Fest update here!


New Map!
We’ve got a spooky new Halloween themed map just in time for spooky season! Enjoy the fall colors, new routes and some new destructible objects to run over.


New Routes!
1 new route was added to The Ville and 2 were added to The Burbs


NPC Characters
Watch out! There’s now NPCs wandering the Burbs and Country levels… If you were to… Accidentally ;) Collide with an NPC there may be some ragdoll effects happening.


If you encounter performance issues in levels with NPCs you can disable them in the settings menu.


Parked Vehicles
We’ve been hard at work updating and adding new set dressing to the levels. This now includes some parked vehicles scattered around. 


5 Second Warning
A 5 second countdown now starts when you’re 5 seconds away from not achieving the 3 star time. Suspense! 


Vertical Inversion
Look down… I mean up! You can now invert vertical controls in the settings menu. Inversion can be selectively set for both player walking controls and van driving controls

Package Highlight Changes
Packages now glow their respective colors when hovering over them instead of the arbitrary green color it was previously. This is also the case when packages are in range of their destinations.


First Person Driving Camera
Switch to a first person hood view while driving. Camera switch control is currently defaulted to “V”.


UI Scaling
We’ve greatly improved UI scaling for those of you with wonky aspect ratios… You know who you are. 

Par Time Tooltips
There’s now tooltips on the route select screen. When hovering on a route it displays the time threshold to unlock each star.


Minor Changes
The vans back doors now have a larger, more forgiving hitbox

Pressing escape now goes back in menus 

Restart button is now also in the pause menu

Leaderboards now have the ability to go to different pages

Van third person camera collision detection improvements 

Added fire hydrant icons to the map screen for better visibility

Added map name within route selection screen

Added a handbrake prompt

Added more mappable keys to the controls menu



Please continue to reach out with suggestions and feedback. You can join our Discord or create a post here on Steams community hub.



See you on the leaderboards! 



-Leland & Joseph

notes.title: Major Update Inbound!
notes.notes:
Hello all! Thanks for playing Parcel Dash and giving lots of feedback and bug reports!



Our next update to the demo will be coming in about a week (We're aiming to push the update September 21st) which will be right in time before Next Fest! 



To tease a couple big things, we're releasing a new map! This new map is spooky themed, just in time for spooky season! There will also be new routes added to The Ville and Burbs levels. 



In addition to this new content there's going to be a lot of quality of life improvements and bug fixes.



Thanks again! Super excited to get this big update out to everyone!



-Leland & Joseph

notes.title: Tutorial Update & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Tutorial
We've added a package throw section to the tutorial. Players will now have to prove they can put the cube in the square hole before continuing. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281277/7e3b6007986ed239eae0c04b270cc8985e889b8a.png"]

A few additional bits of information was added to the tutorial as well. We're hoping to make some of the important mechanics more clear. 


Additions/Changes
Some minor U.I updates in the main menu to make navigation more clear


Bugs
Fixed one of the song tracks not being associated with the music volume slider... We're sorry for the jump scares of this track being full volume 

Fixed a bug that would cause the packages to catch on fire when picked up

Fixed a bug where pressing "Next Route" wouldn't reset the music and would stay on the current routes track

Fixed a bug that would cause the waypoint arrows to not realign after restarting



Thanks for playing! We've been enjoying seeing players figure out these routes. We'll see you out there!
